result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, and PandaDoc** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

The best choice depends on whether you simply need customers to sign documents or want a more complete system for proposals, contracts, payments, and sales workflows.

My recommendation: **Don't automatically choose DocuSign.** It's a well-known option, but smaller businesses can often get better value from a simpler platform.

## Best e-signature software compared

My shortlist for a typical U.S. small business · 2026

| Platform | Best for | Approx. starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Dropbox Sign** | Simple contracts and signing | \$15/month |
| **signNow** | Budget-conscious businesses | \$8/user/month |
| **PandaDoc** | Proposals, quotes and contracts | \$19/user/month |
| **DocuSign** | Recognized brand and integrations | \$10/month |
| **Adobe Acrobat Sign** | PDF editing and signatures | \$16.99/month |


Prices are indicative advertised annual-billing rates; plan limits and monthly-billing prices vary. ### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — Best overall for simplicity**

(My top pick)

- Easy to send contracts for signatures.
- Clean signing experience for customers.
- Templates and document tracking.
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans, according to current comparisons.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PandaDoc — Best for sales and contracts**

- Create professional proposals and estimates.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Collect signatures and payments.
- Track when customers view documents.

Best if you regularly send proposals to prospective customers.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. signNow — Best budget option**

- Straightforward electronic signatures.
- Reusable templates.
- Signing reminders and workflows.
- Competitive pricing for small teams.

Website: [signNow](https://www.signnow.com/)

## What I would look for before buying

For a small business, these features matter most\:

- **Unlimited or sufficient signature requests\:** Avoid unexpected charges as your business grows.
- **Reusable templates\:** Save time on recurring agreements.
- **Automatic reminders\:** Chase fewer unsigned contracts.
- **Audit trails\:** Keep a record of who signed and when.
- **Mobile signing\:** Make it easy for customers to sign from their phones.
- **Integrations\:** Connect with your CRM, accounting software, or cloud storage.

In the U.S., also check that the service supports the electronic-record retention and consent requirements relevant to your agreements under the ESIGN Act and applicable state laws.

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business\:

- **Mostly sending contracts\:** Dropbox Sign.
- **Sending quotes, proposals and agreements\:** PandaDoc.
- **Keeping costs low\:** signNow.
- **Working with larger companies\:** DocuSign.

One important pricing detail: DocuSign's inexpensive Personal plan only includes five envelopes per month, while its Standard plan includes 100 per user annually. Don't choose based on the entry price alone. search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
